title: PantryPal Recipe Finder
description: Built a recipe recommendation website that suggests meals based on pantry ingredients. Users are able to upload an image of items in their pantry and our website works to detect the items and suggest recipes based on both ingredient match and nutrition levels.

title: Breast Cancer Image Classification
description: Built a machine learning image recognition model capable of detecting benign vs. malignant cells at a variety of different magnifications.

title: Power Outage Pattern Discovery
description: An exploratory data analysis project focused on causes, duration, and regional patterns in U.S. outages.

title: UCSD Colleges Website
description: An interactive website designed to help students explore UC San Diego’s eight colleges and campus life.

title: Socal Geoguesser Image Classifier
description: Built an image classification model capable of detecting which Southern California city (Riverside, Anaheim, San Diego, SLO, Bakersfield, Los Angeles) an image is located in with 92% accuracy.

title: Boston Bike Watch
description: Built an interactive bike traffic visualization using Mapbox and D3 to explore bike ridership patterns across Boston by time and location.

title: Surface Heat in Motion
description: Created an interactive visualization exploring surface heat patterns over time using visual encodings to show spatial and temporal change.

title: US Abortions Visualization
description: Designed an interactive data visualization exploring abortion trends in the United States, using charts and filters to support clearer comparison across categories. Winner of Best Project Awards
